instruction: Candid full-body photograph of a couple walking down a bright white clinic hallway. The woman in the black and white plaid shirt (R2) walks on the left, looking ahead. The man in the white t-shirt (R1) walks on the right, gesturing forward with his right hand lowered while holding her hand. Both wear blue shoe covers. Bright, even overhead indoor lighting illuminates the clean corridor, casting soft shadows on the floor.
